text:
elena_sales: Quick ask 10: Acadia wants a 20m live POC next Tue. They plan ~80 concurrent users with streaming chat. Can we provision an ephemeral scoped hosted key + temporary QPS bump?

mark_soleng: Need numbers: what does 80 clients map to RPS and avg tokens? Also region?

elena_sales: Estimated peak ~400 RPS, avg ~60 tokens per request, region: us-west-2. Streaming required.

otis_sre: Hosted can handle a short burst. Proposal: scoped key with qps=450, window 30m (10m warmup), total_token_limit=60,000,000. Enable telemetry and an automatic fallback to redwood-chat-small if 95p latency > 750ms.

nina_se: I can generate the scoped key. Will include scopes: /v1/chat (streaming), ip_allowlist if they send subnets, telemetry_tag=Acadia-poc. Key will auto-expire at window end.

elena_sales: They want the key by Friday EOD so their infra can test Saturday. Can finance sign off on token cap?

quota-bot: Request created: TEMP_BURST_ACADIA by elena_sales. ID TR-2070003333. Status: pending_finance.

mark_soleng: Cost estimate calc (worst-case): 400 RPS * 60 tokens * 1800s = 43.2M tokens spike. Add baseline and buffer -> ~55M tokens. I'll put a short note to @finance with the numbers.

otis_sre: Ops plan: pre-warm redwood-chat-small in us-west-2, enable KV prefix cache for repeated prompts, set max_response_tokens=200. I'll add dashboard tiles and alerts to #eng-oncall.

nina_se: Example curl for Acadia (replace <SCOPED_KEY>):

curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCOPED_KEY>" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-large","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hi"}]}' \\n  https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/chat/stream

mark_soleng: Once finance approves, nina_se can create the key and I'll flip the quota-bot status.

elena_sales: Thanks team 10. Please prioritize; customer demo timeline is tight.
